summary.tldr: Lets senators and MPs choose the oath of office, the oath of allegiance, or both before taking their seats.
what_it_does: Renumbers section 128 of the Constitution Act, 1867 and adds a rule letting senators and MPs take the oath of office instead of the oath of allegiance, or both.
Adds the text of the oath of office to the Fifth Schedule of the Constitution Act, 1867.
Keeps the oath of allegiance in the Fifth Schedule and adds a note that references to the Constitution Acts, 1867 to 1982 include this Act.
summary.background: Section 128 of the Constitution Act, 1867 is the part of the Constitution that deals with the oath members take before sitting.
